kicker: Unique statements on Q2 FY27 earnings calls
title: Sold out, first orders, price hikes: Q2's boldest lines
dek: M&B Engineering says it is booked into next year, Laser Power won its first HTLS order (₹72.76 cr), Xpro doubled its film capacity and Eureka Forbes plans a 3–4% price rise after Diwali.

read: The statements worth keeping are the ones with a number attached; each of these can be checked against Q3 results.
sources: Company Q2 FY27 earnings calls and results filed on BSE; Vantage analysis
notes: Quotes are verbatim from the companies' Q2 FY27 earnings calls. M&B Engineering (Q2 FY27): “we are fully booked for the current fiscal and also part of the next year.” Its order book was ₹1,109 cr. Laser Power & Infra (Q2 FY27): “This is Laser's first commercial HTLS order.” The order is from Power Grid, worth ₹72.76 cr. UGRO Capital (Q2 FY27): “For the first time in our history, UGRO disbursed more than INR1,000 crores in every single month of the quarter” (₹1,057 cr in July, ₹1,010 cr in August, ₹1,092 cr in September). Xpro India (Q2 FY27): “The new line has doubled our nameplate capacity in India to 8,000 metric tons of dielectric films a year.” GMM Pfaudler (Q2 FY27): “We recorded the highest-ever quarterly order inflow in the company's history”; intake was ₹1,198 cr, which management rounded to ₹1,200 cr. Eureka Forbes (Q2 FY27): “we are looking at a price increase range of between 3% to 4% to be rolled out post Diwali.” Revenue growth is from filed consolidated Q2 FY27 results.
